description: Watch your Claude Code tokens grow a tiny plant in the VS Code status bar and sidebar.
config.executablePath: Absolute path to the `token-sprout` CLI (0.2.0 or newer). Leave empty to search `PATH` and `~/.local/bin`. Machine-scoped, so a workspace cannot change which program runs.
config.visibility: When the plant appears in the status bar.
config.visibility.always: Always show the plant; add the watering progress while Claude is thinking.
config.visibility.thinking: Show the plant only while Claude is thinking, like the Claude Code status line.
config.visibility.hidden: Never show the status bar item (the sidebar view still works).
config.showPile: Repeat the stage emoji once per unit (`🌱🌱🌱 3/20`) instead of showing it once (`🌱 3/20`).
config.suggestClaudeCodeConnection: Offer to connect the Claude Code extension when its conversations bypass Token Sprout. **Don't ask again** turns this off.
